# Product Showcase

`commerce/product-showcase` &middot; section-level &middot; category: commerce

## Purpose

One product shown large, with highlights, price, a button and an optional gallery row.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `product` | product |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `highlights` | listItems |  |
| `gallery` | list of image { src, alt } (2 to 3) |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Product image on the left, details on the right.
- **reverse**: Details on the left, product image on the right. Sets `imagePosition: right`.
- **tinted**: On the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `imagePosition` | one of `left`, `right` | `"left"` |
| `split` | text | `"50/50"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `paddingX` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Side by side as a table row, the gallery is a table row of images. | Stacking works. Gmail on non-Google accounts shows the desktop layout on phones. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('commerce/product-showcase', {
  "product": {
    "image": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/560x640/png?text=Linen%20Shirt",
      "alt": "The Coastal linen shirt in sand, worn untucked"
    },
    "badge": "New",
    "name": "The Coastal Linen Shirt",
    "description": "Our lightest shirt yet, made for hot days and warm evenings.",
    "price": "$120.00",
    "salePrice": "$96.00",
    "discount": "Save 20%",
    "cta": {
      "label": "Shop the shirt",
      "href": "https://example.com/products/coastal-linen-shirt"
    }
  },
  "highlights": [
    "100% European flax linen",
    "Pre-washed for softness",
    "Available in XS to XXL"
  ],
  "gallery": [
    {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/180x220/png?text=Detail",
      "alt": "Close-up of the shirt collar and button placket"
    },
    {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/180x220/png?text=Back",
      "alt": "The shirt from behind on a hanger"
    },
    {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/180x220/png?text=Fabric",
      "alt": "A swatch of the sand-colored linen fabric"
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```
